'''G5-M1 ''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] it was stationed aboard the [[Wanderer-class transport]] [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] when it was [[Assault on the Esseles|attacked]] by the [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] ''[[Emperor's Glory]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
G5-M1 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a repair vendor during "The Esseles" flashpoint.
